known_limitations: The page colour is the portrait's dominant accent blended into the theme background; it is not sampled from the bottom edge of the photo, so a photo whose lower part has another colour dissolves into the dominant one.
A greyscale portrait gives no colour: the page keeps its plain background.
The tint is off when the album colours setting is off.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
